newsitem.title: USA: Woolworth sees Q2 oper net below estimates. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Woolworth sees Q2 oper net below estimates. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]

text.p: Woolworth Corp president and chief operating officer Dale Hilpert said he expects earnings from continued operations to be $0.02 to $0.04 a share below Wall Street's consensus earnings estimates.
Woolworth's consensus earnings estimates for the second quarter ending July are $0.21 (corrects from $0.17) a share, according to First Call.
The operating results are prior to an anticipated $1.66 a share charge related to closing its five and dime stores with some of the locations converted into sporting goods or Foot Locker stores.
